mainEntity.name: Do I have to file an insurance claim to use you?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Many customers pay out of pocket, especially when the repair is close to their deductible. You get the same written estimate either way, so you can decide after you see the number.

mainEntity.name: How does the estimate work with my insurance claim?

acceptedAnswer.text: You receive a written, itemized estimate with dated photos of the damage. Contact your insurer to open or discuss the claim and share that documentation with them; coverage, deductible and approval decisions are your insurance company’s.

mainEntity.name: How fast can you look at my vehicle?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send photos through the estimate form and we will reply with next steps during business hours. If the damage needs an in-person look, we will tell you when to bring it by.

mainEntity.name: Do you repair body damage or replace glass?

acceptedAnswer.text: We are a detail and restoration shop. We handle paint correction, interior restoration, odor and cleanup. Dents and panel repair go to a body shop. Glass replacement is third-party work we coordinate through our glass partner.
